{{Top|leg}}
The '''observation module''' was a [[Mission Function Module]] designed to be used with the [[modular taskforce cruiser]]. Used for intelligence gathering, the observation module cost 6.3 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Crewed by 1,550 [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] officers and [[com-scan]] specialists, the observation module was equipped with five hundred [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] and [[observation droid]]s. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were deployed to the target's perimeter while the ship remained outside enemy territory. Twelve [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] provided defense.
